name: Prospect Security Snapshot
description: A one-page, plain-language public-domain risk report for a first sales conversation: SPF, DKIM, and DMARC from CIPP only after the operator confirms any CIPP use and the domain is a connected tenant's default or initial domain (MX from the agent's own DNS lookups, or unavailable); certificates and exposed services only when a read-only tool or an in-session lookup already has that data; breach mentions only when a tool or a cited public search exists. Labels any check the session cannot perform as unavailable rather than guessing.
